methodology.nativeBefore: 32 MiB estimated resident cache, deferred Settings, virtual working/operation lists; unvirtualized historical diff list
methodology.nativeAfter: 64 MiB estimated resident cache plus virtual historical diff list
methodology.nativeProfile: packaged debug app with optimized first-party crates, real background WKWebView, scripted manual refresh/interaction; not foreground rendering or GPU/JS-heap measurement; no provider/network or cross-product comparison

metrics.name: debug_core_warm_workspace_search
metrics.scope: 10 repositories, 2000 commits each, ten warm queries; two-index baseline versus 64 MiB resident estimate

metrics.name: native_workspace_search_median
metrics.scope: All observed workspace queries, including first indexing query; 10 large-fixture locations

metrics.name: native_workspace_first_search
metrics.scope: First workspace query; cold indexing remains expensive

metrics.name: native_workspace_warm_search_median
metrics.scope: Observed workspace queries excluding the first query

metrics.name: peak_sampled_native_rss
metrics.scope: Native PID RSS, sampled every approximately 2 seconds

metrics.name: peak_sampled_combined_rss
metrics.scope: Native plus new WebKit helpers plus sampled Git; shared pages may be double-counted

metrics.name: post_warmup_webkit_rss_slope
metrics.scope: Fitted RSS trend after five minutes, not JavaScript heap/leak evidence

limitations: Sequential single-host runs, fixed order and filesystem/system cache confounders; not a universal speed claim.
Native before/after differ in both cache admission and historical-list rendering. The first run already contains earlier M86 improvements.
Fixed-duration runs completed different cycle counts; fitted RSS trends do not isolate per-operation allocations or prove absence of leaks.
Background macOS debug/ad-hoc app; no foreground full-workday, GPU/JS-heap, live network/credential or Windows/Linux acceptance.
Rust resident-cache weight is an estimate excluding active workers, allocator overhead and query temporaries.
Core benchmark RSS increased with reusable metadata; native sampled RSS is a different, larger workload.
First indexing query still takes approximately 30 seconds in the native large fixture.
